steps: PORTING RULES (apply to every component in this FEAT): (1) Read the source app's main view file(s) in .../src/views/*.vue and .../src/components/ to understand the business logic. (2) Create a single-file component at src/components/solucoes/<slug>.vue in the WORKTREE (d:/laragon/www/3wonline/0/0-dev/sys/dev/3w_online_site/.worktrees/feature-62-solucoes/). (3) The component is the tool body only — no navbar, no footer, no breadcrumb (SolucaoLayout wraps it). (4) Replace any Pinia store usage with local ref/reactive state. (5) Replace @vueuse/motion v-motion directives with plain Tailwind transitions. (6) Replace custom BaseCard/BaseButton/BaseInput/BaseSelect etc. with equivalent inline Tailwind markup. (7) Keep all Maska masks if the source uses them (maska is available in the main project). (8) Keep SweetAlert2 calls (sweetalert2 is available). (9) Replace Iconify import `from '@iconify/vue'` — already available. (10) Remove all router-link internal nav (links to /calculadora sub-routes etc.). (11) Remove PDF generation imports that depend on standalone app deps (e.g. jspdf) unless jspdf is in the main package.json — check package.json before omitting. Main project has: @iconify/vue, @vueuse/core, @vueuse/motion, date-fns, dompurify, fuse.js, maska, pinia, qrcode, sweetalert2, tesseract.js, vee-validate, vue, vue-i18n, vue-router, zod. (12) Use `<script setup lang="ts">`. (13) Use only Tailwind v3 utilities for styling. (14) Component filename must match the slug exactly (kebab-case).
